description:
Class is in session and Tom Hiddleston, aka Professor Tom, shares 10 fascinating facts about the ancient Roman city of Herculaneum in this new video from National Geographic. Located even closer to Mount Vesuvius than Pompeii, Herculaneum was buried by volcanic mud after the eruption in 79 A.D., preserving homes, artifacts, and even an entire ancient library. Herculaneum offers a rare look into life in the Roman Empire before Vesuvius changed everything.

Learn more about Herculaneum in Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston, now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.

author: National Geographic
description:
What was it like in America's Wild West? National Geographic goes back in time into the history of America's Wild West. This America's Wild West MEGA episode examines the start of manifest destiny and the gold rush that sent people out west, to the railroad boom and cultural clashes, and finally, to the end of the frontier. Featuring four, full episodes:

Gone to Texas - 00:00 
‘Manifest Destiny’ drives more and more Americans into Mexican-owned Texas in search of fortune. Mexican president Santa Anna welcomes them at first, employing them as border patrol against Native Americans. But when Mexico tries to consolidate political power, white Texans rebel, setting off a chain of violence that eventually sees enormous swathes of Mexico ceded to the United States.
